Boston Family Office LLC reduced its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.4% during the second its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 152,886 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 551 shares during the period. Apple accounts for approximately 3.2% of Boston Family Office LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Boston Family Office LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $28,301,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
